address.empty.message: type a feed or page address, like blog.acme.io/feed/
address.empty.note: Why an address can't be read. These are parts of sentences, as a digest shows them: they start lower case unless they start with a name, and have no full stop.

address.invalid: that isn't an address: type one like blog.acme.io/feed/
address.scheme: feeds are read over https:// or http://
address.redirect: the redirect target isn't an address

status.noLocation.message: {host} answered {status} without saying where to go
status.noLocation.note: host: blog.acme.io; status: a redirect's HTTP status, 301

status.notFound.message: {host} answered {status} {statusText}: there is no feed at {address}
status.notFound.note: statusText: HTTP's own words, in English (Not Found); address: blog.acme.io/feed/

status.signIn.message: {host} answered {status} {statusText}: the feed needs a sign-in, which digests don't support

status.tooMany.message: {host} answered 429 Too Many Requests: it limits how often it can be read
status.tooMany.note: 429 Too Many Requests stays as HTTP says it

tooLarge.message: {host} sent more than {mb} MB, the limit for a feed

blocked.private.message: {host} can't be read: {ip} is a private or loopback address. An instance admin can allow private addresses for self-hosted feeds

blocked.special: {host} can't be read: {ip} is a link-local, metadata or multicast address. An instance admin can allow private addresses for self-hosted feeds

blocked.localName.message: {host} can't be read: {name} is a local hostname. An instance admin can allow private addresses for self-hosted feeds

blocked.other.message: {host} can't be read: {reason}. An instance admin can allow private addresses for self-hosted feeds
blocked.other.note: reason: the address the guard refused

unreachable.timeout.message: {host} didn't answer: connection timed out after {seconds} s

unreachable.dns: {host} didn't answer: its name doesn't resolve (DNS lookup failed)
unreachable.tls: {host} didn't answer securely: its TLS certificate isn't valid
unreachable.reset: {host} didn't answer: the connection was reset

unreachable.other.note: detail: the network's own error, in English

notFeed.html.message: {address} isn't a feed: it answered with an HTML page

notFeed.empty: {address} isn't a feed: the document is empty
notFeed.neither: {address} isn't a feed: the document is neither XML nor JSON

notFeed.xml.message: {address} isn't a feed: the XML doesn't parse: {detail}
notFeed.xml.note: detail: the XML parser's own words, in English

notFeed.deep: {address} isn't a feed: the XML is nested too deeply
notFeed.noElements: {address} isn't a feed: the XML has no elements
notFeed.noChannel: {address} isn't a feed: the RSS document has no channel

notFeed.root.message: {address} isn't a feed: an XML document whose root is <{root}>
notFeed.root.note: root: the document's first element, such as urlset

notFeed.json.message: {address} isn't a feed: the JSON doesn't parse: {detail}
notFeed.json.note: detail: the JSON parser's own words, in English

notFeed.notJSONFeed: {address} isn't a feed: a JSON document that isn't a JSON Feed (it has no jsonfeed.org version)

noFeedLink.message: {address} is a web page that links to no feed
